name: scss-variable-suggest
description: Suggests replacing raw values (e.g. 15px) with matching design-token variables as you type, and autocompletes SCSS @mixin/@function calls with their parameter signatures. Accept with Tab or Enter.

variableSuggest.variableFiles.description: Glob patterns (relative to each workspace root) for files to scan. SCSS ($name: value;), Less (@name: value;) and CSS custom properties (--name: value;) are parsed as variables; SCSS @mixin/@function definitions are parsed for name+signature completion. Matched against every open project — good for conventional filenames.

variableSuggest.projectVariableFiles.markdownDescription:
Exact variable file paths (relative to each open workspace root), for projects whose variable file doesn't match `variableSuggest.variableFiles`' naming conventions. Applies to every open project — no workspace folder name to match. Set this in your *User* Settings to pin precise paths without adding any config to the project itself:
```json
"variableSuggest.projectVariableFiles": [
  "baseplate/source/stylesheets/_variables.scss"
]
```

variable.description: SCSS map variable name, without the $ (e.g. "colors").

omitTrailingIfEquals.description: Optional: drop the leaf's final key from the call when it equals this value (e.g. "base"), matching a function's default parameter.

variableSuggest.exclude.description: Glob pattern excluded when searching for variable files.

variableSuggest.maxSuggestions.description: Maximum number of variable suggestions to show at once.
